bead.title: Model and emit committed change records
bead.description:
PROBLEM: TD-008 CL-1, CL-3, and CL-4 require every committed mutating command on an opted-in queue to materialize as ordered change records with a stable idempotency key, but the record model and mapping logic are split across engine types without a dedicated, verified change-log contract.
ROOT CAUSE: docs/helix/02-design/technical-designs/TD-008-queue-history-change-records.md:43-56 and crates/pqueue-engine/src/command.rs:531-695 define the required record semantics, while crates/pqueue-engine/src/port.rs:115-118 only exposes a generic sink port; there is no child-owned test seam proving the command-to-record mapping across all mutating commands.
PROPOSED FIX: Harden the engine-side record synthesis path so every mutating command path maps through a single, test-covered change-record builder, and add explicit checks for per-queue ordering and the stable idempotency key shape `(tenant_id, queue_id, item_id, backend_epoch, sequence)`.
NON-SCOPE: No Kafka/heimq broker work, no HTTP sink plumbing, no terminal-retention policy change, and no Parquet/Delta export inside pqueue; history remains an external consumer concern.
bead.acceptance:
1. `TestChangeRecordSynthesisCoversAllMutatingCommands` proves every committed mutating command path emits the expected record(s) from the engine-side mapping.
2. `TestChangeRecordIdempotencyKeyIncludesTenantQueueItemBackendEpochSequence` proves the stable dedupe key matches TD-008 CL-3 and stays tenant-scoped.
3. `TestChangeRecordBatchPreservesCommandPositionOrder` proves one queue's emitted batch stays in `CommandPosition` order and does not imply cross-queue ordering.
4. `go test ./... -run 'TestChangeRecordSynthesisCoversAllMutatingCommands|TestChangeRecordIdempotencyKeyIncludesTenantQueueItemBackendEpochSequence|TestChangeRecordBatchPreservesCommandPositionOrder'`
5. `lefthook run pre-commit`
6. `lefthook run pre-push`
